variants: The sleeve is the control: the record peeks out on hover and stays out, spinning, while playing. The host supplies the artwork, tint and state.

sections.title: Page header
variants: Stacked, for a narrow page
Leading element, truncated line, and fixed height
Trailing element on the title line, without centering
Title only

sections.title: Card grid
variants: Below the breakpoint, a single column

sections.title: Page column
variants: Narrow: smaller gutter, stacked header, and one column
With the scrollbar's own color, without tinting

sections.title: Panel header
variants: PanelHeaderSizing::SIDEBAR: 26 px high
PanelHeaderSizing::PANE: 32 px high
PanelHeaderSizing::CARD: 28 px high
PanelHeaderSizing::POPOVER: 24 px high

sections.title: Back, close, and long title
variants: Title only, and tools aligned to the top edge (center_tools: false):

sections.title: A field in place of the title
A tint behind the header
variants: top_background_fade(color, height): paint only, behind the container's content. bottom_background_fade does the same from below.

sections.title: Sidebar panel
variants: 6 px padding and gaps on the palette surface.

sections.title: Resize handle between panels
variants: The strip between two panels is the resize handle: it lights up on hover, and the host moves the boundary while dragging.

sections.title: Panes divided by resize handles
variants: Chat beside a diff over a terminal, 2:3 and half and half to start. Drag a boundary: no pane goes under 80 px.

sections.title: Folded library
variants: A rail of pictures where the library was. Its hints open at once at their side; the button at its head unfolds it.
current(id) keeps the page shown filled; playing(id) marks what plays. Folded and open side by side:

sections.title: A long rail
variants: More items than fit: they scroll under the head.

sections.title: Peek at the right edge
variants: The closed queue leaves a strip: hover it to see it reach out, click it to open the queue.

sections.title: Peek at the left edge
variants: On either side the strip takes the room it reaches into: the main view gives way.

sections.title: Progress
variants: Flat: square ends for a meter in a dense list.

sections.title: Skeleton
variants: Skeleton::circle and two Skeleton::line of different widths: a person and two lines of text.
Skeleton::block: a card, an image or a preview.
Skeleton::new without a width fills the room it is given; .height(20.0).radius(4.0).
SkeletonGroup::rows(id, palette, 4): lines of varying length, 28 px apart.
.icon(true).row_height(36.0).fractions(&[0.8, 0.5]): a leading square, and the shares repeat in order.

sections.title: Text shimmer
variants: Muted text with a highlight in the palette's text color passing over it.
.colors(base, highlight): the same over the host's own two colors.

sections.title: Ticker
variants: The slot always measures two lines: content below it stays in place.

sections.title: Closing slot
variants: When removed, its last image fades while the slot closes.

sections.title: Labels
variants: A tone takes the color an alert of that tone gives its icon. Outlined, it is the edge and the label.
A color of the host's own is drawn as a tone is.
A dot or an icon before the label takes the label's color.
The remove button reports its ID; the host drops the tag. Tab reaches it, Enter and Space press it.
Disabled: muted, and the remove button keeps its place without answering.
One digit alone is a circle. A chip is as wide as its label; it does not truncate.

sections.title: Wrapping
variants: Element::row(chips).gap(6).wrap(): a chip that does not fit starts the next line, and the box grows with its lines.
line_gap(12) spaces the lines apart from the chips; without it they are gap apart.
Removing a tag pulls the ones after it back; Tab walks the remove buttons line after line. The disabled chip keeps its place.

sections.title: Count
variants: Count: 3. Zero shows no mark; above 99 it reads 99+.

sections.title: Dot
variants: Something is new, without saying how many.

sections.title: Maximum and zero
variants: max(9), the default 99, max(999), a zero that is shown, and a zero that is not.

sections.title: Color
variants: The palette's text color unless the host passes one, such as an alert color for urgency.

sections.title: Corner and size
variants: Any corner of the child's box; a taller mark with a thicker ring, its own ink and face.

sections.title: In a toolbar
variants: Click the bell: the mark goes and no button moves.

sections.title: Disabled
variants: The badge has no state of its own: a disabled control keeps its mark.

sections.title: Avatar
variants: Without a photo, the first letter of the name in upper case. Sizes 16, 24, 32 (the default), 48 and 96.
With a photo, which the host crops to a square.
A lower-case name, one that starts with spaces, one in another script, and no name at all.

sections.title: Group
variants: 6 people, limit(4). The first lies on top; the rest are counted.

sections.title: Limit
variants: Five with no limit, five with limit(3), three with limit(3), and a limit of zero, which is one.

sections.title: Size
variants: 16, 24, 32 (the default) and 48. The size replaces each avatar's own.

sections.title: Overlap
variants: 0, a quarter (the default), 0.4 and 0.6, the most there is.

sections.title: Ring
variants: On a raised ground the ring takes its color with ring(palette.raised).

sections.title: Edge cases
variants: One person, 150 with limit(2), which reads 99+, nobody, which draws nothing, and a group with a blank name in it.

sections.title: The same pattern: Environment
variants: The card, frame and rows are a separate component (FramedCard); here they surround a project environment.

sections.title: Context window
variants: Hover over a category, open Files and remove one, or compact the conversation: numbers update and cells empty themselves.

sections.title: Bottom sheet
variants: A fixed title and footer, a scrolling body, and a downward drag to dismiss.

sections.title: Image viewer
variants: Click a picture: the viewer covers the window. Left and Right move through the three, the header zooms, and Esc, the close button or a click outside closes it.

The native host clears cached textures and pending decodes. Visible pictures are requested again on the next paint pass. Without a picture the viewer waits with a spinner, or shows the error the host gives it.

sections.title: Three-step tour
variants: Left and Right arrow keys or Enter to advance, Esc to close. The rest of the window does not receive clicks during the tour.
